constraints: Display actions are explicit grants. A data action never supplies show. All field dependencies are local to the owning resource.

Target route_entry allows only an input/resolution shell. Query session_id/batch_id/job_id never supplies authorization. Missing ID shows locator input; valid ID resolves only its exact entry before facts or command.
No target entry may automatically list/create/run/read_status/poll. Starting an explicit job-status view is the only reason to poll, and only after actual authorization.
Chat run uses agent_chat.use AND private_chat_session.run; attach is independent. Without session_id, run UI needs explicit create action to create a session, never implicit create.
File surfaces remain embedded in a permitted chat host. Preview does not allow image original GET. There is no new file-center route.
Show_submit has a visible preparation dependency precheck AND (submit_skip OR submit_upsert); each formal mutation API remains independently authorized by its selected mode and actual full input.
A page with multiple source surfaces is an OR for admission only. Actual mixed import submission is an AND over all selected sources/targets, decided by the server.
Import expense void may reuse the local file input to preview only; no automatic generic precheck or submit. K=false keeps amounts null without removing the entire preview.
Report/export hard C/S/K/F are inherited from their owning data actions; the display descriptor repeats the same closed fields for editor explanation and never grants them.
Plain /chat and /import retain existing legacy page gating only for never-cutover resources. Canonical seed show eligibility must use actual old page visibility, not new API readability.
API-only renameChatSession, stateless agent APIs, import single upload and import job list get no fabricated UI surface.
Named authorization-admin control entry is governed by actor_capabilities and uses GET /api/authz/accounts, never ordinary /accounts as an implicit target finder.

actor_capabilities.read_accounts/edit_account_profiles express only data/command eligibility. Ordinary directory, activity and profile surfaces additionally require their explicit show action, including for named admins.
Catalog boundaries are a separate closed read-only registry, never employee module IDs or an allow source. Generator consumes authoritative backend boundaries separately.
